# Barelytics

> Self-hosted, first-party page-view analytics with daily SQLite aggregates and Strict Mode enabled by default.

Use these links selectively for the task at hand; they point to authoritative sources rather than repeating them.

- [Project overview](README.md): product scope, supported runtimes, and entry points.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): product, installation, security, privacy, and integration guides.
- [Behavior-contract index](spec/README.md): intended shared behavior and test vectors; follow its links for the specific contract.
- [Privacy contract](spec/privacy-model.md): Strict and Extended profiles and data behavior.
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): deployment and capability limits; [fact sheet](docs/facts.md): concise product facts.
- [Framework integrations](docs/integrations/README.md): implementation recipes.
- [FTP installation](INSTALL.md): PHP shared-hosting deployment.
- [Development and verification](CONTRIBUTING.md): supported PHP environment and local checks.
- [Agent operating rules](AGENTS.md): repository-wide workflow, safety, and navigation.
- [Project changes](CHANGELOG.md): released user-visible changes.

Barelytics counts page views, not people. It is self-hosted and does not make legal-compliance guarantees.
